reasons.file-write: The optional recovery cache (CCR) and optional log directory write only when a caller leaves ccr on or names a log_dir. Hosts pass ccr=False and no log_dir (the Hermes plugin and the DeepSeek Harness worker both do). Retire by making ccr default to False in a major version.
reasons.home-path: DEFAULT_CCR_DIR is the default location of that optional cache. A host never relies on it. New code must take every path from the caller.
reasons.network: The optional LLM-summary strategy (strategy='summarise') posts to a caller-supplied endpoint, loopback by default, remote only with an explicit opt-in. The default strategy never reaches it, and no host enables it.
